answer: Beacon-decay stops bulk fakes. Each identity files a violet beacon seal and locks 70 credits. The seal melts like a glacier, halving each epoch unless a fresh task voyage renews it, never a replay; a lapsed seal burns the bond. Each fake pays 60 per epoch: 1,000 fakes pay 60,000, lock 70,000, against a 40,000 pool, losing 20,000 each epoch. A rented voyage bears the lender's seal, burning both bonds. Honest work renews free, keeping its share.
